build_transformer_model: build a Transformer encoder or decoder model with configurable layers, heads, and embeddings
create_sinusoidal_embeddings: create sinusoidal position embeddings for a Transformer model given sequence length and dimension
generate_text_greedy: generate text from a Transformer decoder using greedy sampling with causal attention
generate_text_beam_search: generate text from a Transformer decoder using beam search with length penalty and early stopping
manage_hypotheses_beam: manage a ranked list of beam search hypotheses with length penalty scoring and early stopping
